'''Transport Corporation of India Limited''' is an Indian [[logistics]] and [[supply chain management]] company headquartered in [[Gurgaon|Gurugram]], [[Haryana]], India. It was founded in 1958 by Prabhu Dayal Agarwal at [[Kolkata]], India.<ref name="f401">{{cite web | title=Transport Corporation of India inaugurates 300,000 sq. ft. eco-friendly warehouse in Kolkata | website=Manufacturing Today India | date=2025-09-25 | url=https://www.manufacturingtodayindia.com/transport-corporation-of-india-2 | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="w721">{{cite web | title=TCIExpress posts ₹18-cr Q1 profit | website=BusinessLine | date=2019-07-30 | url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/economy/logistics/tciexpress-posts-18-cr-q1-profit/article28762713.ece | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>
==History==
Transport Corporation of India Limited was founded in 1958 and  initially as a freight transport company.<ref>{{cite web|title=TCI History |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/transport-corporation-of-india-ltd/company-history/|publisher=The Economic Times|access-date=2 August 2025}}</ref> Later, the company expanded its logistics operations across India.<ref name="e090">{{cite web | title=History of Transport Corporation of India Ltd., Company | website=Goodreturn | date=1970-01-01 | url=https://www.goodreturns.in/company/transport-corporation-of-india/history.html | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>

In 1995, Transport Corporation of India operates TCI Seaways, as its [[maritime transport|sea cargo]] division. The division is engaged in coastal and international shipping activities, including the movement of container, bulk, and project cargo.<ref name="p491">{{cite web | title=TCI Seaways Limited Company Profile, TCI Seaways Limited News on The Economic Times | website=The Economic Times | date=1995-02-22 | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/company/tci-seaways-limited/U60222TN1995PLC030272 | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="q365">{{cite web | title=Transport Corporation of India: En route to growth | website=BusinessLine | date=2016-07-03 | url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/portfolio/stock-fundamental-analysis-india/transport-corporation-of-india-en-route-to-growth/article8804127.ece | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>

In 1996, Transport Corporation of India started the TCI XPS division, which later became TCI Express. The [[Division (business)|division]] provides domestic and international [[courier]] services by road, rail, and air, and provides e-commerce delivery services in India.<ref name="f298">{{cite web | last=Standard | first=Business | title=TCI set to launch courier service | website=Business News, Finance News, India News, Stock Markets BSE/NSE News, SENSEX, NIFTY,  Personal Finance News | date=2005-10-18 | url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/tci-set-to-launch-courier-service-105101801045_1.html | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="m877">{{cite web | last=Bureau | first=Vishal Balabhadruni & BL Research | title=TCI Express: Good business prospects, but expensive valuation. What should you do with the stock? | website=BusinessLine | date=2023-06-17 | url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/portfolio/stock-fundamental-analysis-india/tci-express-good-business-prospects-but-expensive-valuation-what-should-you-do-with-the-stock/article66977051.ece | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>

In 2008, TCI Express was incorporated as TCI Properties (Pune) Limited. In 2025, It was renamed TCI Express Limited, and in 2016 the division was demerged and became an independent publicly listed company.<ref name="r930">{{cite web | title=TCI Express: A stock worth watching? Strong financials point to growth | website=Logistics Outlook | date=2024-05-20 | url=https://www.logisticsoutlook.com/logistics/tci-express-a-stock-worth-watching-strong-financials-point-to-growth | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="f298"/>

In 2008, Transport Corporation of India incorporated TCI Developers Ltd as a wholly-owned subsidiary. The division focuses on the development of [[Commercial property|commercial]] and [[residential]] properties, along with [[warehouses]] and [[logistics]] parks.<ref name="y863">{{cite web | title=TCI Developers Stock Price Live NSE/BSE | website=CNBCTV18 | date=2022-11-10 | url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/tci-developers-share-price/TCI07/ | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="h620">{{cite web | title=TCI Developers Announcement, Latest News on TCI Developers | website=The Economic Times | date=2024-04-01 | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tci-developers-ltd/stocksupdate/companyid-29171.cms | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>

Transport Corporation of India operates TCI Supply Chain Solutions (TCI SCS), a division engaged in [[supply chain]] and logistics activities, including warehousing and distribution services.<ref name="tcilbo">[https://web.archive.org/web/20160817203431/http://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/companyProfile?symbol=TCIL.BO Reuters]</ref><ref name="o269">{{cite web | title=TCI stays ahead with a range of specialized services – Motorindia | website=Motorindia – Home | url=https://www.motorindiaonline.in/tci-stays-ahead-with-a-range-of-specialized-services/ | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>

==Joint ventures==
Transystem TLI<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-sector-others/mr-vineet-agarwal-executive-director-transport-corporation-of-india-tci-113111400398_1.html|title=Mr. Vineet Agarwal, Executive Director, Transport Corporation of India (TCI)}}</ref> is a joint venture between TCI and [[Mitsui & Co.|Mitsui & Co Ltd]], which is a logistics partner for Toyota Kirloskar Motors Ltd. in India.

TCI-CONCOR Multimodal Solutions Private Limited<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.thehindu.com/business/tci-concor-float-new-company-for-logistics-services/article950497.ece|title=TCI, Concor float new company for logistics services|newspaper=The Hindu|date=13 December 2010}}</ref> is a joint venture with [[Container Corporation of India]] (CONCOR) for bulk transport by rail and road.
==TCI Foundation==
TCI Foundation, the [[social responsibility]] arm of Transport Corporation of India. The foundation is involved in initiatives related to [[health]], [[education]], women’s development, disability, and disaster relief.<ref name="q253">{{cite web | title=TCI Foundation signs LoI with Government for TB Free India – Motorindia | website=Motorindia – Home | url=https://www.motorindiaonline.in/tci-foundation-signs-loi-with-government-for-tb-free-india/ | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref><ref name="x323">{{cite web | title=- BW Businessworld | website=BW Businessworld | url=https://www.businessworld.in/article/tci-foundation-joins-hands-with-ministry-of-health-for-tb-free-india-109710 | access-date=2025-12-14}}</ref>
